{
  "name": "hono",
  "version": "4.13.18",
  "description": "Web framework built on Web Standards",
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
  "type": "module",
  "module": "dist/index.js",
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts",
  "files": [
    "dist",
    "!dist/**/*.tsbuildinfo"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "test": "tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json && vp test --run",
    "test:watch": "vp test --watch",
    "test:deno": "deno test --allow-read --allow-env --allow-write --allow-net -c runtime-tests/deno/deno.json runtime-tests/deno && deno test --no-lock -c runtime-tests/deno-jsx/deno.precompile.json runtime-tests/deno-jsx && deno test --no-lock -c runtime-tests/deno-jsx/deno.react-jsx.json runtime-tests/deno-jsx",
    "test:bun": "bun test --jsx-import-source ../../src/jsx runtime-tests/bun",
    "test:fastly": "vp test --run --project fastly",
    "test:node": "vp test --run --project node",
    "test:workerd": "vp test --run --project workerd",
    "test:all": "pnpm run test && pnpm run test:deno && pnpm run test:bun",
    "check": "vp check",
    "check:fix": "vp check --fix",
    "lint": "vp lint src runtime-tests build perf-measures benchmarks adapters",
    "lint:fix": "vp lint --fix src runtime-tests build perf-measures benchmarks adapters",
    "format": "vp fmt --check \"src/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"runtime-tests/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"build/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"perf-measures/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"benchmarks/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"adapters/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\"",
    "format:fix": "vp fmt \"src/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"runtime-tests/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"build/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"perf-measures/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"benchmarks/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"adapters/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\"",
    "editorconfig-checker": "editorconfig-checker",
    "copy:package.cjs.json": "cp ./package.cjs.json ./dist/cjs/package.json && cp ./package.cjs.json ./dist/types/package.json",
    "build": "pnpm run remove-dist && vp pack && pnpm run copy:package.cjs.json && publint",
    "watch": "pnpm run remove-dist && vp pack --watch && pnpm run copy:package.cjs.json",
    "coverage": "vp test --run --coverage",
    "prerelease": "pnpm run test:deno && pnpm run build",
    "release": "np --no-publish",
    "remove-dist": "rm -rf dist",
    "build:adapters": "pnpm -r --filter \"./adapters/*\" run build",
    "test:adapters": "pnpm -r --filter \"./adapters/*\" run test",
    "release:adapter": "node ./build/release-adapter.ts"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/index.js",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
    },
    "./request": {
      "types": "./dist/types/request.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/request.js",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/request.js"
    },

part.text:
Fixed and verified.

## Change

**`src/context.ts`** — `Context.res` setter

The old code iterated `this.#res.headers.entries()` and, on every `set-cookie` entry, deleted the new response's `Set-Cookie` header and re-appended only the cookies from `this.#res`. That discarded cookies the handler's new `Response` carried. Worse, since `Headers.entries()` yields one entry per `Set-Cookie`, a naive merge would duplicate cookies on each iteration.

The fix:
- Snapshots both sources (`this.#res` and `_res`) once, before the loop.
- Writes the merged list — middleware cookies first, then the new response's cookies — a single time.
- Skips `set-cookie` in the header-copy loop so it isn't processed per-entry, preserving existing `content-type` behavior.

## Tests (`src/context.test.ts`)

- Updated the existing re-assignment test, which encoded the buggy behavior (asserted the new response's cookie was dropped), to expect both cookie sets.
- Added a regression test mirroring the middleware → handler flow: middleware sets `middleware=1` on `c.res`, handler assigns a new `Response` with `handler=1`, and both are asserted present in order.

## Verification

`pnpm exec vp test --run src/context.test.ts` → **1 file passed, 64 tests passed**.

Changes are left unstaged for review.
